wa_rapple_grapple.evidence: Mountain Project header says "4 pitches" and Supertopo says "Number of pitches: 4"; both confirm the stored count. Neither gives a four-row breakdown.

wa_scarface_3.evidence: The only page found names P1-P4 and then "P5+" finishing pitches with no total; header gives only 1200 ft, Grade III. Nothing confirms or contradicts 6, and the page's P5+ wording is compatible with it.

wa_skeena26.evidence: Mountain Project says "12 pitches" and a climber's trip report lists "Skeena26, 5.8, 12p"; the FA description also says they followed knobs "for a dozen pitches". Stored count confirmed. No per-pitch text found for 8, 10, 11.

wa_south_arete.evidence: Mountain Project says "3 pitches, Grade II"; a Mountaineers route page (seen only as a search snippet, page itself 403) reportedly says three or four pitches. Supertopo's "Number of pitches: 10" counts the easy 2nd-4th class ledge sections, with only two real technical pitches; the Alpine Institute page gave no count.

wa_south_face.evidence: Mountain Project route page for Vasiliki Tower South Face says "250 ft, 3 pitches, Grade II"; a guide service lists "Vasiliki Spire, South Face 5.6 2 pitches". One source for each count, so no basis to change; stored 3 has the primary route page behind it.

wa_sperry_peak_upper_south_ridge.evidence: A search-result summary of the SummitPost page lists the route as 8 pitches, Grade II, 5.4, matching stored 8, but the page itself could not be fetched in full (403/Cloudflare) and its prose gives no total. No second source found.

wa_spire_point_southwest_face.evidence: No source states a pitch count; the trip report describes class 4 scrambling with only the final ~50 feet as actual climbing, which hints the true pitch count may be lower than 5, but nothing is clear enough to change it. SummitPost blocked.

wa_spontaneity_arete.evidence: Mountain Project header says "6 pitches" but its description lists P1-P6 plus an optional 7th; Supertopo says "Number of pitches: 8" (900 ft vs MP 600 ft). Stored 7 sits between them and matches MP's described list; Mountaineers page returned 403.

wa_west_ridge_2.evidence: Mountain Project header says "8 pitches" with P1-P8 each described; Supertopo's text refers to the "final 15 feet of the route on Pitch 8" (its count field reads N/A); NC Mountain Guides says "seven to eight pitches" (its header says 10). Eight is best supported but the second source is implicit rather than a stated total.
